description: This Java class 'RetrieveConnectionLogsStrategy' defines a strategy for handling the 'RetrieveConnectionLogs' command within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging persistence framework. It extends an abstract strategy class to associate the command with a specific connection action.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionLogsStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a strategy to handle the RetrieveConnectionLogs command, associating it with the RETRIEVE_CONNECTION_LOGS connection action.

methods.name: RetrieveConnectionLogsStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the strategy with the RetrieveConnectionLogs class.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the specific ConnectionAction, RETRIEVE_CONNECTION_LOGS, associated with this strategy.
